survey: A classic flying saucer seen from above at a three-quarter angle, tilted slightly toward the camera. Main parts: (1) A brushed-metal disc whose upper surface rises in a shallow cone toward the centre. (2) A raised metal collar ring at the top of the cone. (3) A green glass dome sitting in that collar, so it reads as a cockpit canopy. (4) A dark rounded bumper ring around the outer edge of the disc. (5) About 10 orange running lights set into that bumper ring, spaced evenly around it. They look farther apart at the front only because of perspective. The dome, collar, disc and rim all share the same tilt and centre, and the ellipses agree with each other. The craft floats on a plain background, which suits a flying vehicle, so it needs no support. Nothing passes through anything else, there are no loose parts, and the lights match what a stereotypical saucer has. This is a simplified but internally consistent object.
